finding: Large managed-heap expansion reproduced during Assistant-enabled editor startup without gameplay or MCP commands. It did not reproduce during the matched Assistant-disabled observation. Assistant startup/background work is implicated at package level; a specific allocation stack and permanent leak classification remain unproven.
limitations: Three post-GC samples and one cold startup per condition, not long-duration or repeated statistical testing.
Package initialization can overlap asynchronous tasks; exact allocation peak may fall between samples.
ON was measured before OFF; import/cache warmness and startup compilation times differ.
Probe Process privateMB/workingSetMB returned zero in this Unity environment and must not be interpreted as real process memory. Use the separately recorded Windows process readings.
The previous 16980MiB heap was not reproduced at precisely the same size; this comparison reproduced 12043MiB expansion with zero MCP commands.
